name: hilbert_encode
description: Encode a numeric array along the Hilbert space-filling curve into a single sortable integer. Preserves spatial locality better than Morton — values close in N dimensions stay close in the encoded ordering.

examples.description: Order points by the Hilbert curve so (x, y) neighbors stay adjacent

name: hilbert_decode
description: Reverse the encoding — recover the original N-dimensional array from a Hilbert-encoded integer.

examples.description: Round-trip an encoded integer back to its components (num_elements, return_float, return_unsigned)
examples.code: SELECT hilbert_decode(hilbert_encode([10, 20]::UINTEGER[2]), 2, false, true) AS roundtrip;

name: morton_encode
description: Encode a numeric array along the Morton (Z-order) curve. Faster to compute than Hilbert, with slightly worse locality. The Z-Order optimization used by Delta Lake's earliest implementations.

examples.description: Order points by the Morton (Z-order) curve

name: morton_decode
description: Reverse Morton encoding — recover the original N-dimensional array from a Z-ordered integer.

examples.description: Round-trip an encoded integer back to its components (num_elements, return_float, return_unsigned)
examples.code: SELECT morton_decode(morton_encode([10, 20]::UINTEGER[2]), 2, false, true) AS roundtrip;
